section_header: W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION — COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL
ocr_text:
MT1–22
W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION – COMPONENT PARTS REMOVAL

INSTALLATION HINT: Using SST, install the reverse gear.
SST 09312–20011 (09313–00030, 09313–00040,
09313–00050)

SST

E9897
Z07208

22. REMOVE REAR BEARING RETAINER
(a) Using a torx socket wrench, unscrew the 4 torx screws and
remove the retainer.
Torque: 18 N·m (185 kgf·cm, 13 ft·lbf)
(Torx socket wrench T40 09042–00020)

E6B13
Z02531

(b) Using a snap ring expander, remove the 2 snap rings.
INSTALLATION HINT: Be sure the snap ring is flush with the
intermediate plate surface.

000854

23. REMOVE OUTPUT SHAFT AND COUNTER GEAR FROM
INTERMEDIATE PLATE
(a) Remove the output shaft, input shaft and counter gear as a
unit from the intermediate plate by pulling on the counter gear
and tapping on the intermediate plate with a plastic hammer.
(b) Remove the input shaft from the output shaft.

000855

INSTALLATION HINT:
• Before installing the output shaft, use SST to remove
the counter gear center bearing outer race.
SST 09608–35014 (09608–06020, 09608–06090)
• Install the outer race after installing the counter gear.

SST

JP00079
